name: Codex visual-design cowork replacement
objective: Evaluate Codex-compatible alternatives to Claude Design and DesignSync, select a practical replacement, and implement a complete Codex visual-design cowork workflow covering handoff, operator review, artifact read-back, signoff, implementation handoff, skills, contracts, installer output, documentation, validation, and tests, while retaining Claude Code's existing Claude Design integration where appropriate.

review.note: Codex-native visual cowork is fully integrated, shipped as v30, validated across source/artifact/install lifecycles, and documented in decisions v0033 plus operations v0025.
